svg.title: Lord of Material Works: Three of Pentacles · Mars in Capricorn · Binah (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Mars above the painting and Capricorn below, as Book T places them: "Above and below the symbols Mars and Capricorn." Its ring: number 37 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793138745923-votjr1r9lwd.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
